name: sti-catcher
description: Web app interna para descargar, grabar y convertir video.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @sti-catcher/server" "npm run dev -w @sti-catcher/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sti-catcher/web && npm run build -w @sti-catcher/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
